title: Internal Network Access Management Policy
definition: Maintain documented Virtual Local Area Networks (VLANs) for the organization's endpoint computing system networks.

title: Internal Network Access Management Policy
definition: Maintain documented Virtual Local Area Networks (VLANs) for the organization's server computing system networks.

title: Internal Network Access Management Policy
definition: Maintain documented Virtual Local Area Networks (VLANs) for the organization's hypervisor management system networks.

title: Internal Network Access Management Policy
definition: Maintain documented Virtual Local Area Networks (VLANs) for the organization's software development networks.

title: Internal Network Access Management Policy
definition: Maintain dedicated computing systems on dedicated Virtual Local Area Networks (VLANs) for high-risk computing activities.

title: Internal Network Access Management Policy
definition: Maintain network authentication systems (802.1x) for each of the organization's wired networks.

title: Internal Network Access Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the organization's network authentication systems (802.1x) for each wired network require certificate-based authentication.

title: Internal Network Access Management Policy
definition: Maintain network authentication systems (802.1x) for each of the organization's wireless networks.

title: Internal Network Access Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the organization's network authentication systems (802.1x) for each wireless network require certificate-based authentication.

title: Internal Network Access Management Policy
definition: Ensure the organization's network authentication systems (802.1x) for each wireless network require the use of AES-CCMP to encrypt all wireless connections.

title: Internal Network Access Management Policy
definition: Ensure the organization's network authentication systems (802.1x) for each wireless network require the use of a dedicated wireless network for all devices (guests) not managed by the organization.

title: Internal Network Access Management Policy
definition: Ensure the organization's network authentication systems (802.1x) for each wired or wireless network require health checks of computing systems before allowing them access to the network.

title: Internal Network Access Management Policy
definition: Ensure that each of the organization's endpoint computing systems' Virtual Local Area Networks (VLANs) enforces privatization to prevent computing systems from communicating with other systems on the same VLAN.
